about: Public events on now or starting within 60 days in this place, as schema.org Event records, each with its source URL and the time read. A dated record, not a ticketing service. An empty list means no source covers this place yet, not that nothing is happening.
source_note: Read 2026-11-19T12:12:43Z from www.agendalx.pt and www.cm-lagos.pt and teatrodasfiguras.pt and cm-tavira.pt; sources with no feed or refused are in gaps (https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/events-pt/latest.json). Terms: Strictest of the sources: no reuse licence or terms page was found for any of the four hosts (teatrodasfiguras.pt and cm-tavira.pt show only "Todos os direitos reservados" in their footers, and cm-tavira.pt has no robots.txt). The robots.txt files that exist allow the paths read; agendalx.pt sets Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference. So: reference use only, name the source, link to the event, no AI training. Not reviewed by a person: whether this is enough to republish is for Dinis.
